title: gator-enterprise-config-v1
description: The .gator/enterprise.json presence marker + connection descriptor. Presence of this file with `enabled: true` is the canonical signal that Enterprise capability is configured on this repo. Written by `gator enterprise setup` (Phase 4c-A, 2026-08-01) and consumed by `gator_core.is_enterprise_active(gator_dir)` (Phase 4b-substrate, same day) — fail-closed against missing, malformed, non-object, or `enabled != true`. Removed by `gator enterprise disconnect --yes`. Adding a field is additive; renaming or removing a required field is a breaking change.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, Enterprise integrations must remain inert even if the file is present. Allows temporary Enterprise disable without removing configured connection details.

api_url.description: Base URL of the Enterprise control-plane server. Required when enabled=true; consuming code must validate this.

org_id.description: Organization identifier assigned by the Enterprise server at first connection.

repo_id.description: Optional server-assigned repository identifier (added Phase 4c-C-2, 2026-08-02). Required by `gator enterprise sync` for pulling repo-scoped policies (`GET /api/v1/repos/{repo_id}/policies`). Absent when the operator did not pass `--repo-id` to setup; markers written before 4c-C-2 lack this field and are still valid — sync will report the absence and skip the policy pull instead of erroring, since audit works fleet-wide without it.

connected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this repo was first connected to the Enterprise server.

schema.description: Optional self-identifying schema tag. Recommended for tooling.
